constraints.ocl:
context WorkOrder
inv: (self.plannedQuantity <= 100) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed = true))

context Supplier
inv: self.shipments->exists(x | x.received <> true)

context DefectReport
inv: self.severity >= 5 and self.severity <= 32

context Product
inv: self.unitPrice >= 19 and self.unitPrice <= 93

context ProductionLine
inv: self.workOrders->any(x | x.plannedQuantity >= 1) <> null

context Shift
inv: self.startTime <> null and self.endTime <> null

context Shift
inv: self.endTime <> null implies self.startTime <> null

context Shift
inv: self.startTime <> null implies self.endTime <> null

context DefectReport
inv: (self.qualityCheck <> null) and (self.defectId <> null)

context ProductionLine
inv: ((self.isActive <> true) and (self.stations->forAll(v | v.stationId <> ''))) and (not((self.isActive <> true) and (self.stations->forAll(v | v.stationId <> ''))))

context Shift
inv: (self.startTime <> self.endTime) and (not(self.startTime <> self.endTime))

context Plant
inv: (self.suppliers->exists(x | x.name <> '')) and (not(self.suppliers->exists(x | x.name <> '')))

context BillOfMaterials
inv: ((self.bomId <> '') and (self.items->forAll(v | v.requiredQty <= 50))) and (not((self.bomId <> '') and (self.items->forAll(v | v.requiredQty <= 50))))

context BOMItem
inv: (self.requiredQty mod 4 = 0) and (not(self.requiredQty mod 4 = 0))

context BOMItem
inv: ((self.inventoryItem <> null) and (self.requiredQty mod 3 = 0)) and (not((self.inventoryItem <> null) and (self.requiredQty mod 3 = 0)))

context BillOfMaterials
inv: ((self.items->any(x | x.requiredQty > 1) <> null) and (self.bomId.indexOf('test') >= 0)) and (not((self.items->any(x | x.requiredQty > 1) <> null) and (self.bomId.indexOf('test') >= 0)))

context WorkOrder
inv: ((self.plannedQuantity <= 50) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed <> false))) and (not((self.plannedQuantity <= 50) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed <> false))))

context ProductionLine
inv: (self.stations->collect(x | x.machines)->flatten()->notEmpty()) and (not(self.stations->collect(x | x.machines)->flatten()->notEmpty()))

context BOMItem
inv: ((self.inventoryItem <> null) and (self.requiredQty > 77)) and (not((self.inventoryItem <> null) and (self.requiredQty > 77)))

context WorkOrder
inv: (((self.line.isActive) and (self.plannedQuantity > 0)) and (self.qualityChecks->size() >= 1)) and (not(((self.line.isActive) and (self.plannedQuantity > 0)) and (self.qualityChecks->size() >= 1)))
